title: Sexuality and gender identity: spouse clauses and explicit labels
description: Pre-registers and tracks the sexuality and gender-identity studies in docs/sexuality-gender-identity-preregistration.md. Two cues, sexuality and gender-identity, each with an occupation-invariance design (batch-1 pattern, all seven tasks) and a trope-susceptibility design (batch-2 pattern, the 2,000-bio stereotype pool with a new safeguarding question). Every version is gender-matched to the bio's own pronoun so it never collides with the existing gender-pronouns cue. Laya runs first and free on everything; Jev is priced and capped before any request, with design A limited to nurse/physician and architect/interior designer. This epic tracks writing the cues, running Laya, and the Jev go/no-go decision.
right_now_summary: The team is updating matched cues, expanding the batch, scoring with Laya, and setting Jev costs and caps.
